execution_flows.name: Customer Charge & Batch Billing Flow
steps: BillingController.chargeCustomer() overwrites shared singleton field 'channel' with HTTP method and extracts customerId/amountCents from raw Map payload.
Constructs raw ArrayList containing one InvoiceRecord and calls BillingManager.processBatchBilling() with 8 arguments.

processBatchBilling() checks status=='PAID' and currency=='USD'/'JPY' via == reference equality to apply 8%/10% tax, or invokes GatewayClient.sendCharge(customerId, 100L) in a retry loop for non-positive amounts.

Calls private @Transactional saveAuditTrail() (self-invocation bypasses Spring proxy), writes to static raw HashMap INVOICE_CACHE using LegacyDateHelper, optionally reads circularController.lastChannel(), and swallows exceptions in an empty catch block.

state_and_storage: Unsynchronized process-local static raw HashMap BillingManager.INVOICE_CACHE (src/main/java/com/example/billing/service/BillingManager.java:17).
Mutable singleton controller field BillingController.channel overwritten on every HTTP request (src/main/java/com/example/billing/controller/BillingController.java:20).
execution_flow_map.error_and_concurrency_model: Thread-unsafe Servlet container execution: concurrent requests race on BillingController.channel and unsynchronized HashMap INVOICE_CACHE; BillingManager swallows all audit/cache exceptions in an empty catch block (line 83) and GatewayClient prints stack traces to stderr while blocking indefinitely without HTTP timeouts.

findings.description: Core runtime dependency vulnerability CVE-2022-22965: spring-framework: RCE via Data Binding on JDK 9+

findings.evidence: Hardcoded secret literal assigned to 'GATEWAY_SECRET' (OWASP ASVS)
findings.recommendation: Move secrets to environment variables or a secret manager and rotate exposed keys.

findings.description: GatewayClient.GATEWAY_SECRET embeds a hardcoded live-style secret token literal directly in source code.
findings.recommendation: Remove the literal immediately, rotate the credential, and inject it via Spring @ConfigurationProperties backed by a secret manager or environment variable.

findings.description: Trivy reports CRITICAL CVE-2022-22965 (Spring4Shell) against spring-boot-starter-web@LATEST (is_unpinned_specifier=True: static SCA evaluates full historical CVE range until locked, while live Maven attempts Spring Boot 4.2.0 and fails compilation).
findings.recommendation: Pin an explicit patched Spring Boot 3.4.x BOM release in pom.xml and commit Maven Wrapper (mvnw) so both builds and SCA evaluate deterministic artifacts.

findings.description: .github/workflows/build.yml triggers on pull_request_target without an explicit permissions block and uses mutable actions/checkout@main, creating a high-severity CI token/supply-chain risk.
findings.recommendation: Switch trigger to pull_request, add explicit permissions: { contents: read }, and pin actions/checkout to a full commit SHA.

findings.description: Live Maven build failed with 'bad class file: spring-boot-4.2.0.jar (class file has wrong version 61.0, should be 52.0)' because pom.xml uses <version>LATEST</version> with Java 1.8, and Dockerfile fails because openjdk:latest no longer exists on Docker Hub. This blocks test execution, coverage, and startup verification.
findings.recommendation: Pin Spring Boot 3.4.x BOM with Java 21 LTS in pom.xml, add eclipse-temurin:21 Dockerfile, and verify clean offline mvn test + JaCoCo execution.

findings.description: BillingManager injects BillingController (circularController) via field @Autowired creating a runtime cycle, and stores unbounded request state in static raw Map INVOICE_CACHE.
findings.recommendation: Remove circularController upward dependency, adopt constructor injection across Controller/Service/Client, and externalize INVOICE_CACHE to Redis or a typed repository.
Break the cycle by extracting shared interfaces/models into a lower layer.

findings.description: processBatchBilling has cognitive complexity 56, 8 parameters, raw List/Map generics, stale Javadoc (@param obsoleteToken), String == reference equality at lines 52/55/57, empty catch at line 83, and calls private @Transactional saveAuditTrail() (bypassed by Spring AOP proxy and missing spring-tx).
findings.recommendation: Decompose processBatchBilling with a typed command record, fix String equality to .equals()/enum (confirming behavior via Stakeholder Decision Log), log/propagate exceptions via SLF4J, and move transactional persistence to a dedicated repository bean.

findings.description: pom.xml targets Java 1.8, resolves spring-boot-starter-web with non-deterministic version LATEST, and depends on deprecated javax.servlet and JUnit 4 without a committed Maven Wrapper.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade to Java 21 LTS and Spring Boot 3.4 BOM (Jakarta EE 10, JUnit 5 Jupiter), pin all coordinates deterministically, and commit mvnw.

findings.description: Pentest suite (.pni/pentests/examples/java/api_spring_messy) could not execute against BillingController.chargeCustomer (ANY /charge) because container build failed compiling spring-boot-4.2.0.jar under Java 8.
findings.recommendation: Restore deterministic Java 21 + Spring Boot 3.4 buildability first, then re-run web_pentest to verify authentication, method restrictions, and HTTP security headers on POST /charge.

findings.description: Dockerfile builds from deprecated/mutable openjdk:latest, copies entire workspace without .dockerignore, and runs as root.
findings.recommendation: Adopt a multi-stage eclipse-temurin:21-jdk / 21-jre-alpine image with a dedicated non-root USER and .dockerignore.

findings.description: BillingController mutates singleton instance field 'channel' on every request (race condition), exposes /charge to ANY HTTP method via @RequestMapping, and binds raw Map without Bean Validation or auth.
findings.recommendation: Remove mutable field 'channel', restrict to @PostMapping('/charge') with a typed @Valid ChargeRequest Java record, and add authentication/authorization.

findings.description: BillingManagerTest.testSmokeRun only instantiates InvoiceRecord and calls getAmountCents() without any assertEquals/assertThrows or coverage of BillingManager, BillingController, or GatewayClient.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to JUnit 5 Jupiter + Mockito + MockMvc characterization tests covering POST /charge, tax calculation, retry flows, and gateway error paths with >=80% JaCoCo line coverage.

findings.description: High cyclomatic complexity or length in `processBatchBilling` (length=57 lines, branches=13, cognitive=56).
findings.recommendation: Decompose into cohesive helper functions with clear single responsibilities.

findings.description: GatewayClient imports java.net.http (Java 11+) while pom.xml targets 1.8, creates HttpClient.newHttpClient() without connect/read timeouts, calls System.getenv directly, and logs via System.out/printStackTrace.
findings.recommendation: Upgrade toolchain to Java 21, configure Spring RestClient/HttpClient with explicit timeouts and @ConfigurationProperties, sort imports without wildcards, and adopt SLF4J.

findings.description: No dependency lockfile found despite declared dependencies.
findings.recommendation: Commit a deterministic lockfile (e.g. uv.lock, package-lock.json, Cargo.lock).

findings.description: README documentation is missing or minimal (< 10 lines).
findings.recommendation: Document architecture overview, setup instructions, and usage in README.md.
Pin dependency versions or enforce lockfile-based reproducible builds.

consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Restore deterministic Java 21 + Spring Boot 3.4 buildability first, then re-run web_pentest to verify authentication, method restrictions, and HTTP security headers on POST /charge. / Remove mutable field 'channel', restrict to @PostMapping('/charge') with a typed @Valid ChargeRequest Java record, and add authentication/authorization.

consolidated_findings.primary_description: BillingManager injects BillingController (circularController) via field @Autowired creating a runtime cycle, and stores unbounded request state in static raw Map INVOICE_CACHE.
consolidated_findings.combined_evidence: BillingManager injects BillingController (circularController) via field @Autowired creating a runtime cycle, and stores unbounded request state in static raw Map INVOICE_CACHE. | processBatchBilling has cognitive complexity 56, 8 parameters, raw List/Map generics, stale Javadoc (@param obsoleteToken), String == reference equality at lines 52/55/57, empty catch at line 83, and calls private @Transactional saveAuditTrail() (bypassed by Spring AOP proxy and missing spring-tx).
consolidated_findings.merged_recommendation: Remove circularController upward dependency, adopt constructor injection across Controller/Service/Client, and externalize INVOICE_CACHE to Redis or a typed repository. / Decompose processBatchBilling with a typed command record, fix String equality to .equals()/enum (confirming behavior via Stakeholder Decision Log), log/propagate exceptions via SLF4J, and move transactional persistence to a dedicated repository bean.

summary: legacy-billing scores 66/100 (Grade C, with -10pt qualitative deductions across all 7 axes relative to the 76 deterministic AST baseline) due to compounding build, architectural, and security debt. Live Docker runtime verification proved an immediate causal chain: pom.xml's unpinned spring-boot-starter-web:LATEST resolves Spring Boot 4.2.0 (JDK 17+ bytecode 61.0) against a Java 1.8 target (52.0), crashing Maven builds and blocking JaCoCo coverage and DAST pentesting, while Dockerfile fails on deprecated openjdk:latest. Inside the codebase, defects concentrate in BillingManager.java (circular BillingController dependency, cognitive=56, 8 params, static INVOICE_CACHE, String == bugs, empty catch, broken private @Transactional), GatewayClient.java (hardcoded GATEWAY_SECRET, Java 11 API mismatch, missing HTTP timeout), and BillingController.java (mutable singleton channel race condition, unauthenticated ANY /charge).
